parts.display_text: You have a vertical spring of unknown spring constant, cylinders of unknown masses, a digital scale and a stopwatch. Design an experiment to determine the spring constant. State what to measure, how to reduce uncertainty, and what graph to use.

answer.text: Measure each attached mass m with the scale. Displace it slightly and time several complete oscillations, repeating each measurement. Calculate T = total time/number of oscillations. Repeat for several masses. Plot T² against m; its gradient s = 4π²/k, so k = 4π²/s. Keep oscillations small and do not exceed the spring’s elastic range.
